rejected_alternatives.reason: micrometers, calipers and gauges are not retractable tape measures
not a drawing, marking-out or calculating instrument
not self-adhesive plastic tape; it is a measuring instrument

classification.rationale: Heading 9017 expressly names measuring tapes for use in the hand. The polyester tape and ABS/steel housing do not change this (chapter 90 note 1 exclusions inapplicable). Residual subheading 9017.80 Other instruments applies; ruling G87211 classified a retractable tape measure there.

facts.material: acacia (tropical) wood board; steel strainer, two steel bins with lids, steel rack

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 4419 tableware and kitchenware of wood covers the board; steel components are kitchenware of heading 7323, so the set is prima facie in two headings; chapter 44 note 1 does not exclude wood kitchenware
GRI 3(b): set put up for retail for the specific need of food prep; essential character given by the acacia wood cutting board (the main, largest component around which the system is built)
GRI 6: 4419.20 of tropical wood, residual Other 4419.20.90.00 (board is not forks/spoons)

rejected_alternatives.reason: steel kitchenware components are subordinate; board gives essential character
bamboo chopping boards only; this is acacia, a tropical wood
tropical wood has its own subheading 4419.20
forks and spoons only

missing_facts: relative weight/value of the wood board versus the steel components
classification.rationale: A retail set of a tropical-wood cutting board plus steel strainer, bins and rack. Wood board is taken as the essential character under GRI 3(b), leading to 4419.20.90.00 (Other, of tropical wood). No directly matching ruling was found, so none is cited.

hardware for buildings; not a mounting fitting
